_why: The household words for a room this site names differently. Every entry is measured, not guessed: the 'queries' and 'covered' figures are from ops/keyword-demand.json's 2026-10-02 harvest, which ran the VOCABULARY_PROBES seeds added to ops/keyword_demand.py for exactly this question. A word earns a place here only if people type it AND this site does not already answer for it.
_rule: Do not add a word with no measured queries. 'master closet', 'rec room', 'ensuite' and 'lounge' were all considered and all returned zero, so naming them would be inventing demand. Do not add a word the site already covers: 'utility room' (13 queries, 9 covered), 'linen closet' (51, 24), 'coat closet' (21, 11), 'walk in closet' (34, 15) and 'front hall' (6, 4) are all answered already and adding them would be noise.
